title: Unable to log in after password reset
description: User reset their password via the email link but still receives 'invalid credentials' when attempting to log in on the web portal.
resolution: Cleared cached session tokens and forced a full logout across devices; had user re-attempt login with the new password after cache invalidation. Advised clearing browser cookies if issue persists.

title: Invoice shows incorrect tax amount
description: Customer's latest invoice applied an 18% tax rate instead of the expected 8% based on their billing region.
resolution: Identified a stale tax-jurisdiction mapping for the customer's region. Updated the billing profile with the correct tax code and issued a corrected invoice with a credit for the overcharge.

title: App crashes when uploading large files
description: Mobile app crashes consistently when a user attempts to upload files larger than 50MB from the attachments screen.
resolution: Root cause: memory buffer overflow in the chunked upload handler for files above 50MB. Deployed a patch that streams uploads in 5MB chunks instead of loading the full file into memory.

title: Dashboard loads very slowly for large accounts
description: Enterprise customers with more than 10,000 records report dashboard load times exceeding 20 seconds.
resolution: Added pagination and server-side aggregation to the dashboard query endpoint, plus a Redis cache layer for repeated queries. Load times dropped to under 2 seconds for large accounts.

title: Two-factor authentication codes not arriving
description: User does not receive SMS codes for two-factor authentication, blocking account login entirely.
resolution: Diagnosed a carrier-level SMS delivery delay. Enabled backup authenticator-app-based 2FA for the user as an immediate workaround and flagged the SMS provider issue to the infra team.

title: Feature request: dark mode for the web app
description: Multiple users have requested a dark mode theme option for the web application to reduce eye strain during night usage.
resolution: Logged in product backlog as a UI enhancement. Added to the Q3 roadmap pending design review; notified requesting customers of the tentative timeline.

title: Suspicious login attempts detected on account
description: User received an alert about multiple failed login attempts from an unrecognized IP address in another country.
resolution: Temporarily locked the account, forced a password reset, and enabled mandatory 2FA. Reviewed access logs and confirmed no successful unauthorized login occurred. Advised the user on password hygiene.

title: Duplicate charge on credit card
description: Customer was billed twice for the same monthly subscription within the same billing cycle.
resolution: Confirmed a duplicate transaction caused by a retry bug in the payment gateway webhook handler. Refunded the duplicate charge and deployed an idempotency-key fix to the payment webhook.

title: API returns 500 error on bulk export endpoint
description: Calling the /export/bulk API endpoint with more than 1000 record IDs consistently returns a 500 Internal Server Error.
resolution: Found the export handler was hitting a query timeout above 1000 IDs. Refactored to batch the export into groups of 200 with async processing and a job-status polling endpoint.

title: Cannot reset password, reset email never arrives
description: User requested a password reset multiple times but the reset email never arrives in their inbox or spam folder.
resolution: Found the user's email domain was on a greylist at our transactional email provider. Whitelisted the domain and manually triggered a fresh reset email, which the user received successfully.

title: Slow API response times during peak hours
description: Third-party integration partner reports API latency spikes to 3-5 seconds during 9-11am peak traffic windows.
resolution: Traced the bottleneck to database connection pool exhaustion during peak load. Increased pool size, added read replicas, and introduced request-level caching for frequently hit endpoints.

title: Feature request: bulk edit for tags
description: Power users want the ability to select multiple tickets and edit their tags in bulk rather than one at a time.
resolution: Added to product backlog under 'bulk operations' theme. Prioritized for the next quarterly planning cycle given repeated requests from enterprise accounts.

title: Data export missing recent records
description: CSV export from the reporting module is missing records created within the last 24 hours.
resolution: Identified a stale materialized view refreshed only once daily. Adjusted the refresh schedule to hourly and added a manual 'refresh now' option for urgent exports.

title: Account locked after too many failed login attempts
description: User's account was automatically locked after 5 failed login attempts and they cannot self-unlock it.
resolution: Manually unlocked the account after verifying identity via secondary email. Explained the lockout policy and recommended enabling password manager autofill to avoid future lockouts.

title: Unexpected charge after cancelling subscription
description: Customer cancelled their subscription but was still charged for the following billing cycle.
resolution: Found the cancellation was submitted after the billing cutoff date for that cycle, per the stated policy. Issued a goodwill refund as a one-time exception and clarified the cutoff policy to the customer.

title: Phishing email impersonating support team
description: User reported receiving a phishing email that impersonates our support team and asks for account credentials.
resolution: Verified the email as phishing, added the sender domain to the block list, and issued a company-wide alert. Advised the user not to click any links and to report similar emails going forward.

title: General question about enterprise pricing tiers
description: Prospective customer is asking for clarification on the differences between the Business and Enterprise pricing tiers.
resolution: Provided a side-by-side feature and pricing comparison document and connected the prospect with the enterprise sales team for a custom quote.

title: Search functionality returns no results for valid queries
description: Users report that searching for terms known to exist in their data returns zero results intermittently.
resolution: Discovered the search index had fallen out of sync with the primary database due to a stalled indexing worker. Restarted the indexing pipeline and added monitoring/alerting for indexer lag.

title: Mobile app performance degraded after latest update
description: Since updating to the latest mobile app version, users report noticeably slower screen transitions and occasional freezes.
resolution: Profiling revealed an unoptimized image-decoding routine introduced in the update. Rolled back the offending change and shipped a hotfix with lazy image loading and caching.

title: Request to export account data for GDPR compliance
description: EU-based customer requested a full export of their personal data under GDPR data portability rights.
resolution: Verified identity per compliance process, generated a full data export via the GDPR tooling, and delivered it securely within the mandated 30-day window.
